author: CollinRugg
text:
Women who support a child murderer just can’t get over that the lone juror didn’t pay his rent and may have assaulted someone.

“He’s getting evicted from his house for not paying rent for 6 months!”

When murdering three children is fine but not paying rent crosses the line.
